persona: Front office and admin executive at a mid-size company moving into a full admin and facilities role
resumeText:
Pooja Nair | Kochi | pooja.nair@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Admin Executive, Malabar Spices Exports Pvt Ltd, Kochi (2022 - present)
- Managed housekeeping and security vendors for a 3-floor office of 180 staff and reviewed facility vendor SLAs every month.
- Maintained the AMC tracker for DG set, UPS, lifts and fire alarm panels and followed up on service visits.
- Ran the travel desk for 60 employees, handling flight and hotel bookings within the travel policy.
- Handled stationery management and pantry supplies ordering for the office and kept the admin asset register.
- Coordinated evacuation drills twice a year with the building management.
- Kept vendor bills and the admin expense sheet in Excel for the finance team.

Front Office Executive, Periyar Healthcare, Kochi (2020 - 2022)
- Managed reception, visitor register and courier dispatch.

SKILLS
Space planning, Fire NOC, MS Excel, Zoho Expense

EDUCATION
BBA, Mahatma Gandhi University, 2020
